recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-33976 unless PA later chooses to make near sorting behavior stricter than the current clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-33976 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request asking whether Location searches using the near parameter are implicitly sorted by distance and how clients can request the closest matches when the calculated distance is returned in Bundle.entry.search rather than on the Location resource.
initial_application: The issue was applied by ecb4dd444f3c065bac2460eb9df26b4f66b2af4a, which added the Location Positional Searching near-sort guidance and updated the Location-near SearchParameter description. Commit 98ea87dae0a4e9ad4ad4c780ae3322607f099ba1 later adjusted SearchParameter line breaks.
additional_context: PA minutes show the January 2022 decision to add guidance and the April 2022 refinement that coordinated FHIR-33976 with FHIR-27157's Location-near units and algorithm clarification. FHIR-40693 later corrected the example URL parameter from _sortby=near to the current _sort=near syntax.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini lists Location as an active approved resource, source/location/location-notes.xml already describes near sorting as an ordered set with dependability caveats and requires near when sorting by near, and source/location/bundle-Location-search-params.xml already contains the requested algorithm-undefined caveat.

related_jiras.note: Its Location-near unit handling and algorithm caveat were explicitly considered in the final FHIR-33976 text.
A later source commit corrected the FHIR-33976 example URL parameter from _sortby to _sort.

evidence_items.learned: This confirms the final WG intent that current source should provide guidance without defining a single distance algorithm.

evidence_items.learned: The current source should be checked against this more detailed refinement, not only the shorter Jira resolution summary.

evidence_items.learned: The source already contains the substantive sorting guidance requested by FHIR-33976.
